# tbepreport

R package for compiling and visualizing an integrated ecosystem health
report card for Tampa Bay.

## Installation

Install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/tbep-tech/tbepreport):

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("tbep-tech/tbepreport")

library(tbepreport)
```

## Issues and suggestions

Please report any issues and suggestions on the [issues
link](https://github.com/tbep-tech/tbepreport/issues) for the
repository.

# Package index

## Analyze data

Functions for converting raw data to indicator outcomes, and for
combining indicators into bay segment scores.

- [`anlz_category()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_category.md)
  : Combine indicators into a single score by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_fw_nonnative_abundance()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_fw_nonnative_abundance.md)
  : Non-native species abundance outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_fw_nonnative_obs()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_fw_nonnative_obs.md)
  : Non-native species occurrence points, clipped and assigned to a bay
  segment
- [`anlz_fw_nonnative_richness()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_fw_nonnative_richness.md)
  : Non-native species richness outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_fw_tbni()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_fw_tbni.md)
  : Tampa Bay Nekton Index (TBNI) outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_hab_seagrass_coverage()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_hab_seagrass_coverage.md)
  : Seagrass coverage outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_hab_seagrass_transect()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_hab_seagrass_transect.md)
  : Seagrass transect frequency of occurrence outcome by bay segment and
  year
- [`anlz_indicators()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_indicators.md)
  : Stack indicator outcomes into one long-format table
- [`anlz_score()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_score.md)
  : Overall bay segment score across all four indicator categories
- [`anlz_sed_peltel()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_sed_peltel.md)
  : Sediment quality (PEL/TEL) outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_sed_tbbi()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_sed_tbbi.md)
  : Benthic index (TBBI) outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_wq_attain()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_wq_attain.md)
  : Water quality attainment outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_wq_fib()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_wq_fib.md)
  : Fecal indicator bacteria (FIB) outcome by bay segment and year
- [`anlz_wq_load()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_wq_load.md)
  : Nutrient loading outcome by bay segment, year, and indicator
- [`anlz_wq_thresh()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_wq_thresh.md)
  : Water quality threshold attainment outcome by bay segment, year, and
  variable
- [`anlz_wq_tidalcreeks()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/anlz_wq_tidalcreeks.md)
  : Tidal creek condition outcome by bay segment and year

## Show results

Functions to visualize indicator scores.

## Internal datasets

Supporting datasets used by the other functions.

- [`aoi_shp`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/aoi_shp.md)
  : Area of interest boundary for non-native species occurrence data
- [`bayseg_shp`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/bayseg_shp.md)
  : Bay segment boundaries for non-native species occurrence data
- [`plot_category()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/plot_category.md)
  : Sunburst plot of indicator outcomes for one category, bay segment,
  and year
- [`plot_score()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/plot_score.md)
  : Sunburst plot of indicator, category, and overall outcomes for one
  bay segment and year
- [`sgsegest`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/sgsegest.md)
  : Seagrass coverage estimates by bay segment and year

## Utility functions

Utility functions used by other functions or standalone.

- [`util_fw_fetch_fim()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_fw_fetch_fim.md)
  : Fetch the Tampa Bay FIM non-native species dataset
- [`util_fw_fetch_nas()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_fw_fetch_nas.md)
  : Fetch USGS NAS non-native species occurrences for a set of HUC8
  watersheds
- [`util_fw_nonnative_areas()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_fw_nonnative_areas.md)
  : Bay segment and AOI areas for non-native species density
  calculations
- [`util_fw_nonnative_long()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_fw_nonnative_long.md)
  : Reshape a non-native metric's wide year-by-segment table to long
  format
- [`util_outcome()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_outcome.md)
  : Convert raw indicator values to a 0-1 outcome score
- [`util_percentile()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_percentile.md)
  : Convert a wide data frame of values to percentiles by mean and
  standard deviation
- [`util_rdataload()`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbepreport/reference/util_rdataload.md)
  : Load an RData file from a URL
